title: The shifted zero-section exceptional value is constant
statement: In [def-pur-conventions] and [def-pur-affine-line-datum], let $Y$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and let $e\mid n$. The transported finite exceptional inverse image of the zero section $s:Y\to\mathbf A^1_Y$, applied to the actual root coefficient sheaf $A(1)[0]$, satisfies $Rs^!A(1)[2]\cong A_Y[0]$. The object is the identity/proper-compactification value `closedTerm` of [lem-pur-retracted-support-localization-comparison].

source.place: first paragraph, localization triangle through the good-truncation identification

proof.text: Use affineLine_support_geometry for the quasi-compact complement and exists_comparison for a distinguished triangle whose first object is the transported exceptional value, middle object Rp_*A(1), and third object Rpi_*j^*A(1). Compare the exact pullback of the input with its canonical root coefficient sheaf.

Relative Kummer makes Rp_*A(1) the root sheaf in degree zero, identifies H1(Rpi_*A(1)) with the constant sheaf, and kills degrees at least two. Right derived direct image on a single sheaf is nonnegative. The composition of adjunction units and uniqueness of adjoints show that H0 of the restriction arrow is invertible; no independent coefficient-pullback compatibility is assumed.

The long exact sequence kills Hq of the first object for q other than 2: in degrees 0 and 1 use invertibility of H0 of restriction, and elsewhere use the zero outer terms. Its connecting map H1(Q) to H2(B) is mono and epi, hence invertible. Shift by two and use the single-object equivalence of the heart to obtain the constant complex.

    (h : P.ramificationIndex ∣ P.level) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (a : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of P.field.k))
    [IsSeparated a] [LocallyOfFiniteType a] [QuasiCompact a]
    [IsClosedImmersion (zeroSection Y)] :

      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor (EtSheaves P (Line Y)) 0).obj
        (P.twistEtale h (Line Y))))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧ ≅ P.derivedSheaf h Y false)
